mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sub_app (code, name, version, revision, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by, deleted) VALUES (#{code}, #{name}, #{version}, #{revision}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, NULL, NULL, #{deleted}) ON CONFLICT (code) DO UPDATE SET name = EXCLUDED.name, version = EXCLUDED.version, revision = EXCLUDED.revision, deleted = EXCLUDED.deleted, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = NULL WHERE sub_app.revision < EXCLUDED.revision
INSERT INTO sub_app_entry (code, environment, remote_entry) VALUES (#{code}, #{row.key}, #{row.value})
INSERT INTO sub_app_requirement (code, dependency, min_version) VALUES (#{code}, #{row.key}, #{row.value})
mapper.select: SELECT code, dependency, min_version FROM sub_app_requirement WHERE code IN #{code} ORDER BY code, dependency
